title: Feel better soon!

before.predict: Look at the picture. Who is ill today?

text.title: Get well, Davron!
paragraphs: Malika: Hi Davron, you are not at school today. Are you **ill**?
Davron: Yes. I have a **headache** and my throat hurts. My mother is taking me to the **doctor** at four o'clock.
Malika: Oh no! You should drink hot tea with lemon. My grandmother always says that.
Davron: Thank you! I am in bed now. The **doctor** says I must take this **medicine** three times a day and **rest** for two days. I am reading a book about space. It is very interesting!
Malika: Do not worry about school. I can bring your books to your house. We have maths homework — page 42. Our teacher says you can do it next week, so do not worry.
Davron: You are a good friend. I feel **better** already!
Malika: Get well soon! See you on Friday. And please drink that tea with lemon!
